text:
Maya: Midday async — pushed PR #412 for auth policy change, noticed canary started returning 429s around 11:02. Wasn't able to repro locally.
Oliver: On it. Which route saw the 429s? front/api or edge/proxy?
Maya: front/api mostly. We'll see `x-route: /v1/generate` in the logs. Logs excerpt:
```
[11:02:14] 429 response from rate-limiter: tenant=acme route=/v1/generate key=user:123 limit=100 window=60
```
Oliver: Hmm looks like the rate-limit config for that tenant was still using default 100. The new policy change should have bumped to 200 but maybe rollout didn't update global overrides.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for prod/us-central/front-api (deploy id d-78)
Sina: Two quick things — check `policies.yaml` merge order (overrides at bottom win), and confirm the rollout job that touches `tenant_overrides` ran. I had a flaky job last week.
James: I can pair for 30m. Maya, can you drop a curl reproducer? Something like:
```
for i in {1..150}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." https://front.redwood.ai/v1/generate & done
```
Maya: Nice, will try that and post results. If we can repro I'll open a quick rollback PR for the policy change and we can reapply with a migration.
Oliver: Temporary mitigation - increase `burst` to 80 for front/api in staging. I'll open a small PR and tag you @Maya.
Maya: Thanks. Blocker: need someone to approve the rollback PR if it shows repro. Also need SRE to confirm there's capacity headroom for burst increase. :eyes: 
Sina: I'll check infra metrics for token ingestion. If CPU on the pool is fine we can bump burst.
Maya: Plan for today — repro via curl, open rollback if repro, coordinate with SRE, and then reapply policy with migration. Will post updates here.
Oliver: Ping me if you want a hand with the PR, available in 20.
James: Happy to help with the reproducer and run a few more tests.
Maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
